description.value:
Frequency once per round

You may spend two separate Redlines in the same turn. The second is never clean, whatever else would make it so, and you roll its Slip immediately rather than at the end of the turn. Everything that reduces or rerolls a Slip still applies to it.

cinderfall.incomplete: May spend two Redlines in one turn; the second is never clean and rolls its Slip immediately. Deadhand's Redline/Slip mechanic is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus.
